about: WFInfo-ext error catalog. One file for the C# runner, the Swift helper, the Rust libraries and the dashboard. See errors/AGENTS.md for the rules.

areas.PLG: overlay plugin socket (reserved for the overlay client crate)
areas.DST: dataset tools (reserved for the dataset session)
areas.GEN: generated: an error that has no catalog entry

reserved.PLG: PLG-001 to PLG-099: the overlay client crate session adds these
reserved.DST: DST-001 to DST-099: the dataset tools session adds these

generated.site: Namespace.Type.Method of the innermost stack frame in WFInfo-ext code (no line numbers, so a rebuild keeps the code)
generated.code: GEN- followed by 6 lower-case hex digits of (hash >> 8) & 0xFFFFFF
generated.name: words[hash % 64]

errors.name: Lantern
errors.title: Helper not built
errors.description: The wfinfo-mac helper is not next to the runner, so macOS capture and Vision cannot run.
errors.action: Build headless/WFInfo.Headless.csproj on macOS (it compiles the helper), or set WFINFO_MAC_HELPER to the helper's path.

errors.name: Hourglass
errors.title: Helper timed out
errors.description: The wfinfo-mac helper did not answer in time. The first Vision call after a new build can take 40-50 s.
errors.action: Scan again. If it keeps timing out, run `wfinfo-mac selfcheck` in a terminal to see what blocks it.

errors.name: Mirage
errors.title: Helper answer unreadable
errors.description: The wfinfo-mac helper printed something that is not the expected JSON.
errors.action: Rebuild headless so the helper and the runner match, then scan again.

errors.name: Keystone
errors.title: Helper path is wrong
errors.description: WFINFO_MAC_HELPER names a file that does not exist.
errors.action: Fix the path in WFINFO_MAC_HELPER, or unset it to use the helper next to the runner.

errors.name: Anvil
errors.title: Layout library missing
errors.description: libwfinfo_layout (the Rust reward layout) is not next to the runner.
errors.action: Build headless on macOS; it builds headless/macos/layout with cargo. Install Rust with `brew install rust` if cargo is missing.

errors.name: Lodestone
errors.title: libgdiplus missing
errors.description: This mode runs WFInfo's own System.Drawing pipeline, which needs libgdiplus on macOS.
errors.action: `brew install mono-libgdiplus`. The normal scan and --selfcheck do not need it.

errors.name: Inkwell
errors.title: Tesseract libraries missing
errors.description: Tesseract was asked for, but its native libraries were not found.
errors.action: Linux: run inside `nix develop`. macOS: `brew install tesseract`.

errors.name: Shutter
errors.title: Screen Recording not allowed
errors.description: macOS refused the screen capture: the app that started the scan has no Screen Recording permission.
errors.action: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording: allow the app that runs the scan (the terminal, or the app that runs the dashboard), then restart that app.

errors.name: Eclipse
errors.title: Display not connected
errors.description: The chosen display is not connected any more.
errors.action: Refresh the display list and choose again, or choose no display to capture every display.

errors.name: Keyhole
errors.title: Window not on screen
errors.description: The chosen window is closed or not on screen.
errors.action: Bring Warframe on screen, refresh the window list and choose it again.

errors.name: Prism
errors.title: Capture failed
errors.description: The capture tool (grim on Linux, ScreenCaptureKit on macOS) did not produce an image.
errors.action: Check that the capture tool works on its own (Linux: `grim test.png`), then scan again.

errors.name: Smudge
errors.title: Screenshot unreadable
errors.description: The screenshot file does not exist or is not an image.
errors.action: Check the path given to --file and that the file is a PNG or JPEG.

errors.name: Compass
errors.title: Region capture is Linux-only
errors.description: --region uses compositor layout coordinates, which macOS does not have.
errors.action: On macOS use --window <id> or --output <display id> (see `wfinfo-mac windows` and `displays`).

errors.name: Fog
errors.title: Text recognition failed
errors.description: Apple Vision could not read the reward area.
errors.action: Scan again. If it repeats, run `wfinfo-mac selfcheck` to check Vision on this Mac.

errors.name: Smoke
errors.title: Tesseract did not start
errors.description: The Tesseract engine could not be created (libraries or tessdata missing).
errors.action: Run --selfcheck --ocr tesseract to see the cause; see SYS-007.

errors.name: Tangle
errors.title: Layout input invalid
errors.description: The reward layout got no helper answer, or one without the fields it needs.
errors.action: Rebuild headless so the helper and the layout library match, then scan again.

errors.name: Knot
errors.title: Layout failed
errors.description: The reward layout library returned an error.
errors.action: Scan again. If it repeats, the crash report in crash-reports/ has the details.

errors.name: Driftwood
errors.title: EE.log not found
errors.description: Warframe's EE.log was not found, so the automatic scan cannot start.
errors.action: Start Warframe once so it writes EE.log, or pass --log <path> (or set WFINFO_EE_LOG).

errors.name: Ripple
errors.title: Log events stopped
errors.description: The file watcher on EE.log failed (for example the Linux inotify limit), so the watch checks the log every 250 ms instead.
errors.action: Nothing is needed; the watch retries file events every 10 s. On Linux, raise fs.inotify.max_user_watches if it repeats.

errors.name: Dial
errors.title: UI scale unknown
errors.description: EE.cfg was not found or its UI scale did not parse, so the scan estimates the UI scale from the text.
errors.action: Nothing is needed. To fix the scale, pass --ui-scale (0.5-1.25).

errors.name: Squall
errors.title: Price fetch failed
errors.description: warframe.market did not answer, so some prices come from the local sheet or are missing.
errors.action: Check the network. The next scan fetches again; failed fetches are not cached.

errors.name: Static
errors.title: Unexpected price answer
errors.description: warframe.market answered with data the scanner cannot read.
errors.action: Nothing is needed now; if it repeats, warframe.market may have changed its API.

errors.name: Quarry
errors.title: Item list missing
errors.description: market_items.json is missing or unreadable, so part names cannot be matched.
errors.action: Run the OCR suite once (`--test tests/map.json out.json`) or the Windows app, so the databases are downloaded.

errors.name: Ledger
errors.title: Price sheet missing
errors.description: market_data.json is missing or unreadable, so there is no offline price fallback.
errors.action: Run the OCR suite once so the databases are downloaded.

errors.name: Glossary
errors.title: Name table missing
errors.description: name_data.json is missing or unreadable, so recognised names cannot be translated to market names.
errors.action: Run the OCR suite once so the databases are downloaded.

errors.name: Bastion
errors.title: Scans folder not writable
errors.description: The scanner cannot create or write its scans folder in the app data directory.
errors.action: Check the permissions of the WFInfo app data folder.

errors.name: Hollow
errors.title: No reward screen found
errors.description: The capture worked, but no reward name was recognised.
errors.action: Open the fissure reward screen and scan again.

errors.name: Turnstile
errors.title: Scan already running
errors.description: Another scan is running, so this request did not start a second one.
errors.action: Wait for the running scan to finish.

errors.name: Sundial
errors.title: Scan timed out
errors.description: The scan did not finish within its deadline and was stopped.
errors.action: Scan again. The first scan after a new build can be slow (see SYS-002).

errors.name: Scroll
errors.title: Settings unreadable
errors.description: The WFInfo-ext settings file could not be read, so the defaults (all switches off) are used.
errors.action: Change a setting on the dashboard to write a new file, or delete the broken file.

errors.name: Seal
errors.title: Settings not saved
errors.description: The dashboard could not write the WFInfo-ext settings file.
errors.action: Check the permissions of the WFInfo app data folder.

errors.name: Beacon
errors.title: Scan command did not start
errors.description: The dashboard could not start the scan command.
errors.action: Check WFINFO_SCAN_CMD, or that dotnet (macOS) or nix (Linux) is on PATH.
